name: Sorcerer
description: A spellcaster who studied nothing. The magic is in the blood, and a sorcerer bends it on instinct, twisting spells into shapes the careful casters cannot manage.
full: A sorcerer never studied. The magic is in the blood, whether from a draconic ancestor, a brush with wild chaos, or something that happened before they were born, and it comes out on instinct rather than through preparation.

They know few spells but bend them further than anyone. Metamagic is the whole class: twinning a spell onto two targets, quickening it into a bonus action, subtling it past a gag or a grapple. A sorcerer casts less often than a wizard and does more with each cast.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Magic is innate to you rather than studied. Charisma is your spellcasting ability, and you know a small fixed number of sorcerer spells, swapping one on each level up.

features.name: Sorcerous Origin
features.description: Choose the source of your power, whether draconic bloodline, wild magic or another. It grants features at 1st, 6th, 14th and 18th level.

features.name: Font of Magic
features.description: You hold sorcery points equal to your sorcerer level, regained on a long rest. Convert them into spell slots as a bonus action, or convert an unused slot back into points.

features.name: Metamagic
features.description: Choose two ways to bend your spells, such as Twinned, Quickened, Subtle or Heightened, spending sorcery points to apply one, at most one per spell. A third option comes at 10th level and a fourth at 17th.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2 or two ability scores by 1. Cannot increase scores above 20. Gained at 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level.

features.name: Sorcerous Restoration
features.description: Regain 4 expended sorcery points when you finish a short rest.
